content.short: Top competitive auditor Krum Pashov leads Pashov Audit Group, a smart contract security firm trusted by Aave and Uniswap.
content.description: Krum Pashov made his name in public audit contests, and his group now builds a team of senior researchers for each engagement, supported by AI tools. Audits focus on EVM protocols across DeFi, real-world assets and infrastructure, and every report includes reproducible findings and concrete code fixes. The group has completed hundreds of audits for teams such as Aave and Uniswap. The firm has more than 50 researchers, and each audit is staffed by four senior reviewers who are all contest winners. It reports more than 400 audits and over 4,000 vulnerabilities found.
